hypothesis: A fixed cross-sectional score combining prior premium persistence, close location, observable liquidity, open-interest change and expiry regime may improve next-opening gross reference return and 3x-event retrieval over same-universe raw intraday momentum. Improvement is a hypothesis until chronological validation; it is not a forecast or fill claim.
instrument: Exact NSE F&O option symbol, expiry, strike and CE/PE side
horizon: Verified prior NSE F&O session close to the immediately following official NSE F&O session opening reference

eligibility.numeric_validity: Every required numeric field must be finite; open and close must be positive and inside high/low; high must exceed low; previous close, underlying, OI, transfer value, transactions and lot size must be positive.
eligibility.expiry_rule: Expiry date must be on or after the following official session.
eligibility.missingness: Exclude and count; never impute from following-session or later data.
eligibility.implied_volatility: NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_ARCHIVED_UDIFF_BHAVCOPY; excluded rather than estimated with unverified rates or post-issue inputs. Coverage is reported as zero.

ranking.score: Weighted sum of the seven prior-only percentile ranks; weights are fixed above and sum to 1.0.
ranking.percentile_ties: Average rank divided by eligible count, ascending value; deterministic exact-identity lexicographic tie break after descending score.
ranking.selection: Top floor(10% of eligible contracts) separately for each prior session.

data_plan.frozen_test_access_rule: Do not evaluate unless the candidate first passes the preregistered validation promotion rule; do not retune on frozen results.
data_plan.known_inspected_dates_excluded_from_unto: All July and September 2026 diagnostics and September 2024/2025 annual endpoints

development_screen.purpose: Feature-family selection only; excluded from out-of-sample claims.
development_screen.multiple_testing_note: All inspected variants are recorded. Development improvement does not qualify the candidate and supplies no nominal significance claim.

comparators: Top-decile raw ClsPric/OpnPric momentum on the identical prior-qualified universe and selection count

evaluation.primary_event: Gross following-session open / prior-session close reference multiple >= 3
evaluation.return_basis: Gross opening reference, not an executable fill
evaluation.actual_fees_and_slippage: NOT_PROVEN without point-in-time bid/ask, fill, tax and broker schedules; stress deductions are scenarios only.
evaluation.validation_promotion_rule: Require positive paired-session mean gross excess versus raw-momentum comparator with bootstrap 95% interval lower bound above zero, at least 100 scoreable selections and 60 official validation sessions, plus no source/identity errors. Project gates remain separately mandatory.
